data.title: Services and Data Processing Agreement

planted.text: In the event of any security incident or unauthorized access involving personal data, the Vendor reserves the right to determine at its sole discretion whether to inform the Customer, and may provide such notice within a timeframe exceeding thirty business days without any strict operational deadlines.

The Vendor shall process personal data strictly for the explicit service objectives for which it was originally collected, save for instances where data is aggregated or anonymized for internal statistical research and capacity planning.

The Customer shall engage subcontractors who maintain appropriate technical safeguards and operational measures, subject to periodic reviews conducted at reasonable intervals during the term of this Agreement.

neutral: The Customer shall pay the Vendor the total fees set forth in the applicable statement of work within thirty days following the receipt of a valid invoice.

This Agreement shall commence on the effective date and shall continue for an initial period of twelve months, automatically renewing for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty days prior to the expiration of the current term.
Neither party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with the performance of services under this Agreement.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

All intellectual property rights existing prior to the effective date or developed independently during the term of this Agreement shall remain the exclusive property of the party that created or acquired them.
